steps.name: Beinan's Request (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Merimel] in 「Kali」, then turn in the quest to [Beinan].

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Thank you for sharing more stories of the other continents, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I enjoyed talking with you too, Merimel.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Lady Medea has been away quite often lately. Something dangerous is happening, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, how do I explain... Try not to worry too much. Lady Medea and I will take care of it.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: If you say everything will be all right...
(Merimel smiles brightly and takes both of %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: It will be, won't it? All of us in the Kali tribe believe in you. We trust you. If there's anything you need, please tell us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Oh, Beinan?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Sorry to interrupt, Merimel. I need a word with %s... If you haven't finished, I can wait.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: No, we were just finishing. Have you finished your patrol?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Adrica seemed safe, so I came back.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Okay, I see.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Then I'll leave you to talk with Beinan, %s. I'll go sort the materials I've gathered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the matter, Beinan?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: There's something important I need to tell you. Let's go to my usual spot by the village entrance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What could he want to say? I'd better go find out.)

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: You... seem to have been to a place called Knossos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Lady Medea tell you?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I simply remembered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Remembered?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: You may have heard my story before, during your visits to Kali Village.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Perhaps this will be the first time, perhaps the second. Either way, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His memories...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: As a child, I always felt out of place, even with Merimel and the others in the village.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Then ominous memories began to torment me. Only Lady Medea's power kept me whole...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Memories of my people sacrificed by the Deimos Order. Of myself running to escape their 'binding,' until my life force drained away and I collapsed...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Memories of a past life.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: But I felt there were other memories, too. When you and Lady Medea returned, you carried a scent that filled me with a strange nostalgia.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Knossos...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I don't know why that name came to mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beinan... What connection does the Kali tribe have to Knossos?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: I don't know for certain. My memories, our tribe's past... I want to understand them properly. I'm sure Lady Medea does, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I bring you Tears of Light?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: No. I need something from Knossos. Find a stone tablet engraved with a wing design. It must be somewhere important.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somewhere important...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go to Knossos.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. Somewhere important would be Memory of the Heart or Acro's Coffin...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Talos told me to visit often. Should I try him? All right, let's go.)

steps.name: Beinan's Request (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Pasiphae] in 「Memory of the Heart」 and obtain the <Wing-Inscribed Tablet>. Then turn in the quest to [Beinan] in 「Kali」.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You really are interested in me, aren't you? I didn't expect you back so soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You told me to visit and build trust. I wasn't exactly eager, but...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Eager or not, don't deny that you've come to get something you need from me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, that is true...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's getting on my nerves... Still, I shouldn't underestimate him.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Well, tell me.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If you don't want to talk, so be it. I have weeds to pull. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Have you ever seen a stone engraved with a wing design?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hmm. Why do you need that? Did that woman send you for it? Well, it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ask the cat woman trapped in Memory of the Heart to find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean Pasiphae?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yes, her. She has a knack for finding rare things. Good luck, perhaps. She's making quite a racket, though.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: She's causing havoc in there trying to get out. So noisy. If she and the Beastman King ever get out again, they'll certainly try to kill me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And yet, knowing that...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I don't care to explain every detail to an outsider. We have our own circumstances here.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What are you waiting for? Get going. Visit Memory of the Heart before she smashes it to pieces.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you later.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yes. Good luck.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Hi, hi!
(Pasiphae, lounging in a tree, spots %s and jumps down eagerly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Pasiphae. Were you resting?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: ...I want to leave, but I can't find a way out. So I'm just playing around in here. Maybe the answer will come to me while I play?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I'm bored, and I can't even see my darling. I'd searched everywhere and was about to take a nap, and then you arrived.
(Pasiphae's eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Did you find a way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. But I'll do everything I can.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Aww...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I wasn't expecting much anyway. If it were easy, I'd have been out long ago.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Then I'd find that man and... You can guess the rest, right?
(Pasiphae grins and holds up a pair of daggers.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: So, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've come looking for something I need.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I don't have any more heart fragments. What else do you need? Is it for the goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Deciding it should be safe to tell Pasiphae, you briefly explain the Kali tribe's situation.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: ...Daphne's village?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: So the person trying to remember Knossos is like me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But they don't have tails.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: My tail? It's fake. I can take it off and put it back on! Hehehe. My darling made it for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: What's so surprising? Anyway! You need a tablet with a wing design, right? I've got one! I'll give it to you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, thank you!

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But not for free. Perfect timing, I was bored. Fight me! Just enough that neither of us dies! Please, please?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Just handing it over would be no fun. I'll wait at the far end of Memory of the Heart. Meet me there and let's fight!

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Then it's settled! Hehe.
(Eyes sparkling, Pasiphae hurries deeper into Memory of the Heart.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: That was fun! You picked up the tablet I dropped, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: A good run around has cheered me up. I was feeling so miserable.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Thank you... for helping my people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Kali tribe really are your people? But this is a land of beastmen...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: What do you think a beastman is?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Something that walks like a human but looks like an animal, right?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: There are two kinds of people in Creed. Those who walk like humans but have animal faces, and those who look almost human except for their animal ears...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: We're simply people. Living beings.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: We only look a little, just a little, different from ordinary humans like you. I don't know why the humans of Freios make such a fuss...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: No need to look so serious. I'm used to it.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Anyway, give that to whoever needs it. Come back again, okay? And if you happen to see my darling, tell him I miss him!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. See you later, Pasiphae.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Oh, right. I have another tablet... If that one's enough, good. If not, they'll come back. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I wonder what my darling is doing...
